queries: WITH rating_avgs AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film WHERE rental_duration >= 5 GROUP BY rating), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_day) AS value FROM rating_avgs) SELECT r.rating, r.avg_rate_per_day, r.film_count, r.avg_rate_per_day / b.value AS ratio_to_benchmark FROM rating_avgs AS r CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE b.value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.rating

assumptions.assumption: A 5-day rental period meets the cutoff, so long rentals have rental_duration >= 5.

alternatives.interpretation: Only periods longer than 5 days count as long rentals.
